rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
# Debian's extra-magic.patch adds this file of the Debian packaging to the # magic fragments. It has no entries at the moment. install -d -m 0755 debian printf '\n# sorted by Debian bug report number\n' > debian/debian-extra-magic
bh_autotools_dev_update autoreconf -vfi
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -DHOWMANY=0x18000" \ $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --enable-fsect-man5 \ --enable-static \ --disable-libseccomp \ --disable-zstdlib \ --disable-lzlib \ --disable-silent-rules
rules.install:
for ENTRY in magic python3; do install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$ENTRY" done
FULL_INSTALL="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/magic" FULL_PREFIX="$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$FULL_INSTALL" install
# The compiled magic file depends on the architecture and lives in the # library folder. Programs look for it in share/misc and in share/file. install -d -m 0755 "$FULL_PREFIX/lib/file" install -d -m 0755 "$FULL_PREFIX/share/file/magic"
mv "$FULL_PREFIX/share/misc/magic.mgc" "$FULL_PREFIX/lib/file/magic.mgc"
ln -sf ../../lib/file/magic.mgc "$FULL_PREFIX/share/file/magic.mgc" ln -sf ../../lib/file/magic.mgc "$FULL_PREFIX/share/misc/magic.mgc" ln -sf ../file/magic "$FULL_PREFIX/share/misc/magic"
install -D -m 0644 "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/magic/magic.local" \ "$FULL_INSTALL/etc/magic" install -D -m 0644 "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/magic/magic.local" \ "$FULL_INSTALL/etc/magic.mime"
install -D -m 0644 "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/src/file.h" \ "$FULL_PREFIX/include/file/file.h"
rm -f "$FULL_PREFIX"/lib/*.la
cd python bh_python_install --install --root "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/python3"
